s1.text: Day one. You wake up, and nothing feels different.

s2.text: Then you notice. Every day, you wake up exactly one percent stronger.

s3.text: Not just muscle. Speed. Memory. Nerve. Everything.

s4.text: One percent doesn't feel like anything. That's the trap.

s5.text: The average man can bench one hundred thirty five pounds.

s6.text: Day thirty, you're at one eighty. Day one hundred, three sixty.

s7.text: Day two hundred, you bend a steel rod, just to check if it's still steel.

s8.text: And here's what nobody tells you. The math doesn't stop.

s9.text: Day three sixty five, you're thirty eight times stronger than the day you started.

s10.text: You can outrun a car. You can hear a heartbeat across the room.

s11.text: And then, on day three sixty six, you find the note on your door.

s12.text: You're not the only one. Signed, day three thousand six hundred fifty.

s13.text: Ten years of one percent. What would that even look like?

s14.text: Tell us in the comments. Part two is coming.
